description_en: Queries a single table report. More report types may be supported
description_zh: 单表维度分析查询（类型可能会增加）
kebab_example: aliyun airec query-single-report --instance-id airec-cn-o400whm78004 --report-type typeItemTagScene --api-version 2020-11-26 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QuerySingleReport

parameters.description_en:
The type of the single table report. This parameter is required.

Valid values: typeItemValidScene,

typeItemTag,

typeItemTagScene,

typeItemWeightScene,

typeItemRawScene, and

typeItemExpireScene
